meta.homeTitle: Everyday life in Taiwan, handled with you | CROSSING PROXY
meta.homeDescription: CROSSING PROXY helps people from abroad living in Taiwan with parcels, motorbikes, phone lines, and everyday questions. The first chat is free, and nothing starts until you agree.
meta.shippingTitle: International shipping and home pickup | CROSSING PROXY
meta.shippingDescription: Shipping is open to Vietnam, Thailand, Indonesia, the Philippines, and India. Pickup covers Keelung, Taipei, New Taipei, Taoyuan, Yilan, Hsinchu City, and Hsinchu County.
meta.motorcycleTitle: Motorbike buying, selling, and rental | CROSSING PROXY

meta.servicesDescription: Phone and SIM help, everyday questions, air conditioners, translation, and everyday documents. Shipping and motorbikes have their own pages.

meta.lifeTitle: Everyday help and air conditioners | CROSSING PROXY
meta.lifeDescription: Online life advice covers all of Taiwan. Air-conditioner visits cover Taoyuan, New Taipei, Taipei, Keelung, and Yilan.
meta.translationTitle: Translation and everyday documents | CROSSING PROXY
meta.translationDescription: Translation between Chinese and Vietnamese, Thai, Indonesian, Filipino or English, and Hindi, plus help reading and arranging everyday documents. Online, anywhere in Taiwan.

qual.title: Scope and professional work
qual.lead: We can hear what you need for free. When a task requires a professional qualification, we help you reach a suitable, lawful service.
items: We do not handle visas or licensed immigration work ourselves.
We do not give legal advice ourselves.
We do not handle money transfers.
We do not diagnose or give medical advice. We can only suggest a general direction for seeking care. There is no medical partner to name.
qual.partners: If there is a path for visas, immigration, legal help, or lawful money and financial services, the other party’s name, logo, and license are not published on this site.

faq.q: Does the first consultation cost anything?
faq.a: The first consultation is free. If you need the actual service, we explain the work and the fee, and we start only after you agree.

A person can reply in 繁體中文, English, Tiếng Việt, Bahasa Indonesia, ไทย, Filipino, and हिन्दी. You can switch the site language anytime. A language on the site does not mean every professional task is done in that language.

faq.q: Does this website collect my information?
faq.a: There is no inquiry form. The site does not collect, store, or send personal details typed into the site. Free consultation opens LINE. Later messages on LINE are handled by staff of 懿翔實業有限公司. Your language and country stay on your device.

faq.q: Can you file a visa or give legal advice?
faq.a: We do not handle visas or licensed immigration work, we do not give legal advice, and we do not handle money transfers. When a qualification is required, we help you reach a suitable, lawful service. Names and licenses of those parties are not published here.
Hours are 08:00–23:00, and a first reply is usually within an hour.

faq.q: Why are there no numbers on the price table?
faq.a: Where a fixed price is not published, the page says the first consultation is free and a formal quote comes after we confirm what you need. Unconfirmed numbers are not put on the site.

shipping.areaTitle: Where we collect and pick up
shipping.areaLead: Home pickup and arranged collection are in these places: Keelung, Taipei, New Taipei, Taoyuan, Yilan, Hsinchu City, and Hsinchu County. Hsinchu means both the city and the county.
shipping.noticeLead: These are the shared points we already tell people. They are not a complete banned-item list. Rules differ by country, and we explain whether and how something can be sent before you agree.
principles: We do not take meat or meat products.
Batteries and power banks are restricted.
Liquids and medicine are usually restricted.
Before anything is sent, we confirm it again with you for that destination.

privacyPage.title: Privacy
paragraphs: This website does not collect, store, or send personal details typed into the site. There is no inquiry form and no data field.
The free-consultation button only opens the official LINE account at https://lin.ee/SQbAREU . Later messages happen on LINE and are handled by staff of 懿翔實業有限公司.
Your language and country are saved only on your device so the site can remember them. They are not sent to our server.
Site analytics are not turned on.
